The history of coffee

Coffee is one of the most popular beverages in the world. The story of coffee begins in the highlands of Ethiopia, where legend says a goat herder named Kaldi noticed his goats becoming energetic after eating red berries from a certain shrub.

By the 15th century, coffee had spread to Yemen, where it was first cultivated as a valuable crop. Sufi monks used it to stay awake during long nights of prayer.

Coffee houses appeared in Istanbul in the 16th century and became centers of social life, known as schools of the wise.
